How to read this: the line is a demo pipeline, coloured by its worst natural hazard: ground failure (landslide, washout, frost heave), river crossings, wildfire weather and drought. Blue dots are river crossings. Red = send a crew, amber = watch, green = inspect less. Press ▶ on the map to watch climate change shift it from today to 2036. Hover any number for what it means.
